description.value: Banh Mi Saigon is a family-run Vietnamese sandwich shop on Victoria Drive in South East Vancouver, recognized for baking its baguettes in-house daily from a house recipe. The shop has earned praise from Scout Magazine, Gastrofork, and American Express Essentials for its fresh, locally sourced ingredients and standout bread. Its compact menu spans a dozen banh mi variations, Vietnamese desserts, and traditional drinks — a quick, high-quality fuel stop for cyclists passing through East Vancouver.
